# NBAPI 1.3.1

## Brand cleanup

- Replaced remaining public New API branding with NBAPI across README files, docs, about pages, footers, OpenAPI docs, issue templates, and release metadata.
- Updated repository links, update checks, release workflows, Docker image references, service files, Electron metadata, and code samples to use NBAPI/Lorry-San paths.
- Renamed service and poster assets from `new-api`/`newapi` to `nbapi`.

## Runtime compatibility

- Renamed internal NBAPI error types and API error identifiers from legacy `new_api_*` names to `nbapi_*`.
- Switched dashboard and API request headers to `NBAPI-User` and `X-NBAPI-*` while keeping legacy header compatibility for older clients.
- Kept legal upstream copyright notices intact where they are part of source file headers.

## Validation

- Verified public branding scans, tracked filename scans, JSON parsing, encoding sentinel checks, and `git diff --check`.
